text: Please can someone help, I'm a childminder with a 7 year old boy overnight and I'm really scared. His temperature is 37.8. He has a blotchy red rash on his tummy and that one goes pale when I press a glass on it. But there are some little dark purple dots on his legs, like pinpricks, and when I pressed the glass on those they didn't go away at all, I could still see them clearly through it. I did it a few times to be sure. I can't get hold of his parents. What should I do
